svg.title: Before use: the CVs and their index
svg.desc: npm run generate has Gemini write 30 CV PDFs. npm run index has Gemini extract a profile from each; the field check locates every fact in the text, so each has a page, and the profiles go to data/index, JSON held in memory. Each chunk of text is embedded into Pinecone. before use: npm run generate → CV PDFs → Gemini → Field check → data/index. embedding: CV PDFs → Embedding → Pinecone.
svg.text: BEFORE USE: NPM RUN GENERATE, NPM RUN INDEX
